title: Astitva
desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.

title: Sultaan
desc: Don Kabira helps Ayesha in saving her garage from local goons. However, he hides the fact that he was an honest inspector sometime ago after which Ayesha decides to find out the reason for his transformation.

title: Kyaa Kool Hai Hum
desc: Living in Mumbai, Rahul and Karan dream of living luxurious lives despite their meagre salaries. When they get evicted from their apartment for not paying the rent, they hunt for rich girlfriends

title: Filhaal
desc: When Sia watches her best friend Rewa slip into depression because of her inability to bear a child, she offers to be her surrogate. Trouble brews when jealousy finds its way into their relationship.
